faults.quote: Use ödemek for paying bills, prices, or debts.
faults.why: Restates the definition while omitting the irregular stem change (öde- -> ödüyor) and case governance.
Unnatural collocation; Turkish says 'hatasının bedelini ödemek' (pay the price of one's mistake), which is sense 0.
